scripts.postbuild: rocketclimb-sh cp "dist-esm/**/*.js" "dist/**/*.mjs" && rocketclimb-sh fix-esm ./dist && npm run postbuild:icons-bin
scripts.postbuild:icons-bin: rocketclimb-sh mkdir -p ../icons/bin && rocketclimb-sh cp "dist/**/*" ../icons/bin/ && rocketclimb-sh cp ../core/src/*.tsx ../icons/bin/
scripts.clean: rocketclimb-sh rm -fR dist dist-esm && rocketclimb-sh rm -fR *.tsbuildinfo
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
